reviews.reason: Login entry discovery completes asynchronously. The effect first checks loading/discoveryFailed/loginEntryId, then verifies the requested id against the enabled loginEntries before requesting the selector. A local click handler cannot cover a disabled, removed or invalid entry supplied by the initial URL or a later discovery response. sign-in-page tests retain valid URL restoration, invalid-entry chooser fallback and discovery error handling. The relocated visual components do not own the discovery or external-navigation transitions. Reassessed: The lazy form islands consume the route-owned selection and invitation state. The selected-entry guard still reconciles a restored URL with asynchronously discovered visible choices.

The five state axes are the discovered loginEntries, discovery loading/failure and the separately initiated external-entry start id/failure. Discovery resolves asynchronously, while activateLoginEntry and the pageshow listener own external navigation and retry reset. startingRef prevents duplicate starts. A reducer would change representation without repairing a missing transition; sign-in tests cover chooser URL restoration, one-click external start, navigation failure/retry and discovery failures. The relocated visual components do not own the discovery or external-navigation transitions. Reassessed: The lazy form islands consume the route-owned selection and invitation state. The selected-entry guard still reconciles a restored URL with asynchronously discovered visible choices.

One route owner coordinates resolved login entry, invitation and authentication handoff. BuiltinPasswordSignIn and CustomAuthRuntime own actual form/runtime mounting independently; splitting the handoff state across islands would lose the shared activation and redirect guard.
The second authOwner check is a cancellation fence after concurrent me/session reads. Receiving the values is insufficient if the public route or selected entry was replaced during the read.
The invitation banner reports active route context, not a computed result from form controls. role=status preserves the live announcement without introducing an output form association.
